text:
Leah - CS: Quick sync for Oakridge private deploy tomorrow. Need final signoff on networking/IAM/KMS/log delivery before cutover window.
Marco - Network: TGW attachments are done. We're still missing the peer subnet masks from their side (asked infra@oakridge yesterday). Also need the NAT EIP if they use static egress.
Priya - Security: On IAM: they want a cross-account role. We need the exact role ARN and a short trust policy. Prefer we use explicit grant on KMS rather than relying on a broad key policy.
Ethan - Platform: App bootstrapping fails when metadata service can't reach our callback URL. If their egress is via NAT, update allowlist. Also remind them to open port 9411 for tracing.
Leah - CS: Renewal note: account health currently neutral. This cutover is high-impact — failure to deliver on time puts renewal at risk. I'll tag AM and put an escalation if we don't have the role ARN + NAT EIP in 8 hours.
Marco - Network: For clarity I asked for two pieces from Oakridge: (1) worker CIDR (/28 or /27) (2) NAT EIP if fixed. Pinged their network lead at 10:04 PT.
Priya - Security: Sample trust snippet I sent them for the role: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OakridgeCrossAcct"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}`
Priya - Security: For KMS we need explicit grant to that role: I'll prepare grant template and request their KMS key ID. Also need confirmation whether they want key rotation (recommended: yes).
Ethan - Platform: Audit logs destination 94 they want logs to ship into their S3 prefix. Need bucket ARN + put-object policy. Also confirm SSE (we recommend aws:kms).
Leah - CS: I asked them whether retention should be 90d or 365d; they picked 365d for compliance. Noted.
ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance: oakridge-private-cutover - 2030-04-21T01:00Z -> 2030-04-21T05:00Z
Marco - Network: If they are using BGP over DX, I also need their ASN and IPs for peering. Requested LOA docs.
Priya - Security: Example S3 bucket policy I shared (minimal): `{"Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowDelivery","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"deliver.rw-logging"},"Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::oakridge-logs/*"}]}`
Leah - CS: Action summary I'm tracking: networking (Marco) - CIDR + NAT EIP + ASN; security (Priya) - role ARN + KMS key ID + grant template; platform (Ethan) - webhook allowlist + tracing port.
Marco - Network: I'll escalate to their VP of infra if no CIDR by EOD.
Priya - Security: Also ask Oakridge whether they require our team to assume the role during maintenance or they will grant access to our service principal. Different onboarding flow.
Ethan - Platform: I'll publish a tiny smoke test (3 checks) to the runbook: (1) API ping, (2) webhook callback, (3) trace ingestion. ETA 14:30 PT.
Leah - CS: I'll prepare a 5-question post-cutover feedback (NPS + 4 quick flags) and attach it to the runbook. Want to keep it lightweight.
Marco - Network: Confirmed they replied with a provisional CIDR: `10.150.32.0/28` but no NAT EIP yet.
Priya - Security: Received role ARN `arn:aws:iam::777888999000:role/Oakridge-Cutover-Role` from their IAM. I'll draft the KMS grant and send.
Leah - CS: Great progress. If NAT EIP arrives, Ethan please update allowlist. If not, we run with ephemeral egress and may see callback retries.
Ethan - Platform: Understood. I'll make callback retry policy more forgiving for the first 2 hours and watch metrics.
Leah - CS: Final ask: after cutover, can we get a short 5-minute synchronous retro with their infra lead? We want to capture blockers while fresh. Suggest 30-min window the following day.
Marco - Network: +1, helps close the loop.
Priya - Security: Sending KMS grant template now.
Leah - CS: I'll log these action items in CRM and update account health score post-cutover. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
